ADVISORY COMMISSION ON AGING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 11, 2026
  1150 E. 4TH STREET
  LONG BEACH SENIOR CENTER, ROOM 202, 10:00 AM

Judi Clarke, Chair  Clarice Kavanaugh, Commissioner
Sylvia Salcedo, Vice Chair  Phyllis Schmidt, Commissioner
Norma Chinchilla, Commissioner  Harold Sutherland, Commissioner
Carolyn Hines, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  heidi.mazas@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54403  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Advisory Commission on Aging
  meeting of Wednesday, February 11, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54543  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Ramiro Ixtlahuac
  regarding Metro’s On the Move Riders Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54404  Recommendation to receive and file Superintendent’s Update on department
  business.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54551  Recommendation to discuss and, if appropriate, provide direction to staff on
  updating the Advisory Commission on Aging marketing materials.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54530  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Advisory Commission on Aging on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Heidi Mazas at (562) 570-3503 or heidi.mazas@longbeach.gov.
